scripts.clean: clear && pnpx npkill -D -y && rm -rf pnpm-lock.yaml node_modules .templates && pnpm install
scripts.prerelease: pnpm run test:all && pnpm run release:check:versions && node scripts/check-changelog-placeholders.ts
scripts.bump:patch: node scripts/bump-version.ts patch && pnpm run sync-version && node scripts/stamp-changelogs.ts
scripts.bump:minor: node scripts/bump-version.ts minor && pnpm run sync-version && node scripts/stamp-changelogs.ts
scripts.bump:major: node scripts/bump-version.ts major && pnpm run sync-version && node scripts/stamp-changelogs.ts
scripts.bump:alpha: node scripts/bump-version.ts prerelease alpha && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.bump:alpha:minor: node scripts/bump-version.ts prerelease alpha minor && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.bump:alpha:major: node scripts/bump-version.ts prerelease alpha major && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.bump:beta: node scripts/bump-version.ts prerelease beta && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.bump:beta:minor: node scripts/bump-version.ts prerelease beta minor && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.bump:beta:major: node scripts/bump-version.ts prerelease beta major && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.bump:rc: node scripts/bump-version.ts prerelease rc && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.bump:stable: node scripts/bump-version.ts promote && pnpm run sync-version
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:vitest && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:pre-commit: pnpm run test:vitest && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint-staged && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test:ci:fast: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && pnpm run test:vitest
scripts.test:ci:e2e: pnpm run test:vitest && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:bench:compare: ECOPAGES_BENCH=1 pnpm --filter @ecopages/kitchen-sink exec tsx bench/run.mts && pnpm --filter @ecopages/kitchen-sink exec tsx bench/scripts/compare-baseline.ts
scripts.test:bench:startup:compare: ECOPAGES_BENCH=1 node playground/kitchen-sink/bench/startup/run.mjs && pnpm --filter @ecopages/kitchen-sink exec tsx bench/startup/compare-baseline.ts
scripts.test:e2e:static: node e2e/scripts/playwright/run-playwright-batch.mjs browser-router-e2e cache-e2e core-hmr-static-e2e cross-integration-preview-e2e cross-integration-node-preview-e2e docs-e2e react-router-e2e react-router-persist-layouts-e2e
scripts.test:e2e:static:pr: node e2e/scripts/playwright/run-playwright-batch.mjs browser-router-e2e cache-e2e core-hmr-static-e2e cross-integration-preview-e2e docs-e2e react-router-e2e react-router-persist-layouts-e2e
scripts.test:e2e:kitchen-sink: node e2e/scripts/playwright/run-each-project.mjs cross-integration-dev-e2e cross-integration-bun-parity-e2e cross-integration-vite-node-parity-e2e cross-integration-vite-bun-parity-e2e && pnpm run clean:e2e-tmp && node e2e/scripts/playwright/run-each-project.mjs cross-integration-hmr-e2e
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run clean:e2e-artifacts && pnpm run build:e2e:kitchen-sink && pnpm run test:e2e:static && pnpm run test:e2e:dev && pnpm run test:e2e:kitchen-sink
scripts.test:e2e:pr: pnpm run clean:e2e-artifacts && pnpm run build:e2e:kitchen-sink && pnpm run test:e2e:static:pr && pnpm run test:e2e:dev && pnpm run test:e2e:kitchen-sink:pr
scripts.test:gate: pnpm run test:vitest && pnpm run clean:e2e-tmp && node e2e/scripts/playwright/run-each-project.mjs --grep '@stress' cross-integration-dev-e2e
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:portability && pnpm --filter '*' run typecheck
